Our hosting management app had a persistent awareness problem: users could tell that something had happened, but not always what it meant, whether it mattered, or what to do next.

I led a redesign of the notification experience to make account activity clearer, more actionable, and easier to trust. Rather than treating notifications as isolated alerts, I reframed them as part of a broader activity system and designed a dedicated inbox experience around that model.

The problem

The existing experience used a familiar bell-and-popover pattern, but it wasn’t a good fit for the system underneath it.

Our “notifications” were actually built on top of a decade-old account activity model with inconsistent structure, vague messaging, and unpredictable content length. A single item might contain a simple server update or a few paragraphs of technical maintenance details. The UI looked modern, but the experience was hard to scan and difficult to act on.

The approach

# Figma vs. code audit: v2.0 stack (7 frames)

## Context
The v2.0 PR stack rebuilt Projects, case-study (Overview, Deep dive, Walkthrough, Gallery) and About to match Figma. This audit compared every frame's node tree and generated styles (sizes, gaps, fonts, colors, shadows) against the source. It is a static comparison: nothing was rendered, so pixel-level behaviour (stepped corners, font rendering) still needs one render pass.

Overall: the earlier "Match X to Figma" commits were very accurate. Headline sizes, tracking, section gaps, padding, gutters, action-button geometry, About rows, work-history spacing, toast geometry and the 495px loop videos all match to the pixel. What's left is small.

## Decisions already made (no code change)
- Side nav stays 14px / 34px / SemiBold (Deep dive frames). Walkthrough, Gallery and About frames show 16px / 44px in Figma; About's own nav is already 16px.
- Ping red stays #E34F4F everywhere (Figma's #DC2626 on Projects/Overview chips and headline accent is treated as drift).
- Header status order stays Projects-frame order (date, socials, theme tile).

## Confirmed mismatches to fix (smallest first)

1. **"Next project <name>" dim color**: `src/components/ActionButton.astro:121` uses `text-portfolio-muted` (#BBB). Figma: cream at 50% (`rgba(255,249,242,0.5)`), visibly dimmer. Fix: color-mix ink 50% for the `detail` span (the hover/featured override at ~line 164 stays).
2. **Bottom bar distance from window bottom on case-study pages**: `src/layouts/BottomNav.astro:35` uses `sm:pb-[58px]` on every page. Projects frame is 58px (correct), but the case-study window frame (56:12791) puts buttons 10px above the bottom edge. Fix: per-page offset via `data-page="case-study"` in global.css; also revisit `pb-24` on body in BaseLayout.
3. **Gallery captions**: `src/components/case-study/Gallery.astro:36-41`. Figma: every label (BEFORE/AFTER/Loop) is #BBB semibold, including AFTER; code uses ink-colored semibold. The first tile ("Overview") is a single Regular #BBB caption, and its image is 442 x 270.72 (aspect 1440/882), not the 276 crop, so its caption sits ~5px higher than its neighbor.
